claims.sentence: Verdicts depend on the verifier: in one evaluation the same outputs yielded unsupported-citation rates from about 3\% to 18\% depending on the verifier, and verifiers agreed far more on what was supported than on what to flag \citep{goo2026citefaithfulness}.
claims.claim: In one evaluation, identical outputs gave unsupported-citation rates of about 3% to 18% depending on the verifier, and verifiers agreed much more on supported citations than on which to flag.
claims.excerpt: the same agent outputs score about 3% to about 18% unsupported across five gold-validated verifiers, and although the verifiers agree on which citations are supported, they disagree on which to flag (negative-specific agreement 0.27 to 0.30 among the three continuous-scored verifiers)
claims.location: p. 2, Introduction, Contributions (see also p. 9, Sec. 5.4: positive-specific agreement 0.90-0.96 vs negative-specific 0.27-0.30)
